serverCases: the default recipe file is written and loaded
plugin.yml declares the recipes command and permission
shaped recipes craft their result anywhere in the grid
ingredient lists and tags accept any listed material
shapeless recipes ignore positions but count items
cooking and stonecutting recipes carry their settings
a smelting recipe cooks in a real furnace
recipes are registered under the plugin namespace
invalid recipes are skipped with the first reason
reload removes recipes deleted from the file
disabled vanilla recipes cannot be crafted
reload restores vanilla recipes that are no longer disabled
disable and enable edit the file
tagged ingredients craft a MiniMessage-named item with lore
